name: Gunsmith Hierka
desc: The former protégé of [Gunsmith Rosen](entity:gunsmith_rosen), Hierka was really loyal to the [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority)'s [Bureau of Research](faction:bureau_of_research) and had aligned himself with [The Summer Company](faction:the_summer_company) to steal their secrets. Under Rosen's watch, Hierka achieved the rank of gunsmith. Hierka modified Rosen's designs to produce the Rifle Spear, but his deception was eventually discovered.
